products.name: Pic Hider
products.tagline: Private photo & video vault — locked behind your PIN
products.description: Hide photos and videos behind a PIN-encrypted vault (AES-256). Fingerprint/face unlock (works on Class-2 sensors too), built-in viewer with zoom and video playback, and one-tap export back to your gallery. NEW in v1.2.0: photo import and custom shortcut icons work on every phone (crashes root-caused and fixed), a professional step-by-step PIN setup, and fingerprint login that no longer says 'not available' on budget sensors. Also: disguise the app as Calculator, Notes or Gallery, or add a custom home-screen shortcut with any name and picture.

products.name: Cool Widgets
products.tagline: Hand-crafted home screen widgets — clocks, weather, notes, quick tools
products.description: 12 real home screen widgets in 7 categories: a self-ticking Digital Clock (4 themes, 12/24h), Analog Clock, Big Date, event Countdowns, a live Battery Ring, Weather for ANY city you type (no location permission — looked up once), colourful Sticky Notes, a rotating Daily Quote, a permission-free Flashlight toggle, Quick Search, Settings Shortcuts and a Photo Frame. Only two permissions in the whole app (Internet for weather + boot-completed to keep schedules alive after restart), both explained up front. One tap adds any widget to your home screen.
